claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a black Canon DSLR with an 18–55mm lens, but does not confirm 'UK used' or 'clean and sharp' condition.
Witness report does not show any test results (shutter actuation, autofocus, sensor check, or LCD functionality).
Witness report (Photo 2) shows lens barrel markings including 18–55.
Seller statement is incomplete; witness report does not cover the missing part.
Witness identity section names the model as EOS 650D; photos described match a 650D identification from the witness.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says 750D but witness identifies 650D), which affects value and compatibility of parts/accessories.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/label on the camera body (e.g., 'EOS 650D' or 'EOS 750D') and/or the 'About' screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lower-identified model (650D) and treat as standard used condition until model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Camera may not be fully functional (shutter count unknown, autofocus performance unknown, sensor condition unknown).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, live view, autofocus lock on a moving subject, and a sample photo at a fixed setting; include a sensor/speck check photo (e.g., f/16 on a blank wall).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case 'not fully tested' / 'may need service' level.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (fungus/haze, scratches, focus smoothness).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of lens glass at an angle against light (front and rear elements) plus a focus test video showing sharpness changes from near to far.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'lens condition unknown' and assume possible minor defects.

risks.risk: LCD screen condition unknown (dead pixels/brightness) and controls may be worn or faulty.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the LCD showing a bright menu screen and a video of navigating menus; also show rear buttons responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'LCD condition unverified' (possible replacement cost risk).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/uncertain completeness (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card, box).
risks.proof: A single laid-out photo of everything included, with each item visible (battery model, charger label, lens caps, strap, memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/uncertain bundle (camera + lens only) until inclusions are confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo showing the exact model text on the camera body (EOS 650D vs EOS 750D).
Show a working test: power on, live view, autofocus lock on a subject, and one sample photo (plus a sensor/speck check shot).
Provide close-up photos of the lens front and rear glass against light for fungus/haze/scratches.
Show the LCD screen clearly (menu visible) and a short video of button/dial operation.
List and photograph all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card, box if any).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a Canon DSLR with an 18–55mm lens, but the seller’s key points (working condition) are not verifiable from the provided shots, and there is a model conflict (seller says 750D while the witness identifies 650D). Without proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
